qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Local Nordic brand portfolio (Grandiosa, Toro, Jordan, Nidar) and grocery shelf relationships lack structural pricing power. Constrained by powerful Nordic supermarket oligopolies and private label substitution, resulting in sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Structural returns on capital hover at 7.0-9.5%, far below the 12% GAAP ROIC hurdle. Nordic branded consumer goods portfolio faces severe margin compression from concentrated supermarket retail oligopolies (NorgesGruppen, Coop, ICA) and rapid private label encroachment.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle group ROIC consistently hovers between 7.0% and 9.5% across 2019-2025, failing the minimum 12% GAAP ROIC gate. Despite market-leading domestic shelf positions across Norway, Sweden, and the Baltics, operating margins (10-12%) reflect lack of pricing power above inflation against concentrated Nordic supermarket duopolies, necessitating ongoing portfolio restructuring into an industrial holding structure.
